    1. resolveDependencies(BeanLocator, BeanDefinition, Function)

Interface BeanDependencies

@Internal public sealed interface BeanDependencies
The dependencies of one bean instance: the record of what was created for that instance and is destroyed with it. It is reached through BeanRegistration.dependencies().

This is not an API for acquiring beans; that is BeanDependencyResolver and BeanDependencyGroup. It lets code outside the injection module create something on behalf of a bean the container already made. A proxy that selects interceptors for a target does so, so that the unscoped ones are created as dependents of the target and destroyed with it.

  • Method Details

    • resolveDependencies

      <S> @Nullable S resolveDependencies(BeanLocator context, @Nullable BeanDefinition<?> definition, Function<BeanResolutionContext, S> operation)
      Runs a resolution on behalf of the bean. What the operation creates becomes a dependent of the bean, destroyed with it; what it adds through BeanResolutionContext.addDependentBean(BeanRegistration) does too. A failure destroys what was created instead.
      Type Parameters:
      S - The result type
      Parameters:
      context - The context the bean belongs to
      definition - The definition the resolution is rooted at, or null
      operation - The resolution
      Returns:
      The result, or null when the bean is being destroyed or the context cannot resolve on its behalf
